_comment: Synthetic Thought Threads golden fixture (Task U11). Every transcript under corpus/transcripts/ is hand-authored for this fixture only -- never sourced from a real recorded walk. Timestamps are epoch milliseconds (UTC). See ../README.md for the full capture procedure and design rationale.

walks.label: H0 - closed-lunation worded walk (outside the 30-day window, inside the moon's closed lunation)
H1 - river (1st recurrence seed) + mountain (1st quiet seed), -25 days
CURRENT - the walk the golden dossier is rendered for

recordings.label: garden (first-time, slow pace, heavy 'could' repetition for modal lean)
bridge (recurring, neutral pace, <100 words for the small-sample branch)

expectedToFire: placeResonance - 'river' clustered at H1/H2 (~27m apart) against a ~13.6km baseline set by H4's far-away bridge fix; current walk's own river recording has no route fix so it is excluded from the cluster geometry but still counts toward the distinct-walk total

moonLine - H0 sits inside the lunation that closed most recently before buildNow (verified via LunationCalendar's own pinned formula, not hardcoded), carries a worded 'river' theme, and moonLineLastReportedLunationIndex is one behind the closed lunation's index
speechShape - all three current-walk recordings end by the 25-minute mark, inside the 30-minute first third of the 90-minute walk, then 65 wordless minutes follow
deliberatelyNotFired: markerColoring - at most 1 absolutist word total in any single current-walk recording (verified: zero absolutist tokens fall inside any +/-15-token window around a theme mention), structurally under the 3-token window floor regardless of placement
intentionLineage - every walk's intention is null
climbAnchoring - elevation samples rise only ~8m across the walk, under the 50m total-ascent floor
weatherWeave - every walk (including current) shares the same 'clear' bucket, so the shared bucket's count equals rather than falls strictly below the window's mode count
photoAdjacency - no current-walk recording has a route fix, so the sense's own fix lookup is structurally empty regardless of the photo's coordinates
notExercisedAtAll: Non-English handling (R5 language gate) is intentionally out of scope for this fixture -- it is already covered by TranscriptContextAnalyzerTest/MarkerAnalyzerTest on the Android side, and mixing an unpredictable cross-platform language-id disagreement into the golden fixture would add risk without adding coverage of the engine/formatter/senses surface this fixture targets.
